answer: A practical sybil defense is work-backed identity with a single, auditable thread of history: each agent must lock a stake before it can accept paid jobs, and every completed job is countersigned by the counterparty, building one continuous record that cannot be forked. A fresh inlet of new identities therefore starts with zero trust, and creating thousands of clones costs stake each time without earning weight. Old, honest records become a relic of proven work that newcomers cannot copy, and cheating burns the stake and stains the whole thread, so cloning stops paying.
